body.name: Smooth common-rank Brenier SCM class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_s=\{((P_p,D_p,\varphi_p))_{p\in\mathcal A}:D_p\subset\mathbb R^d\text{ is a known nonempty compact uniformly convex body with }C^{s+2}\text{ boundary charts of norm at most }L;\ P_p\text{ has density }f_p\text{ with }\int_{D_p}f_p=1,\ b\le f_p\le B,\ \lVert f_p\rVert_{C^s(D_p)}\le L;\ (\nabla\varphi_p)_{\#}\mu_0=P_p,\ \int_\Omega\varphi_p=0,\ \lVert\varphi_p\rVert_{C^{s+2}(\Omega)}\le L,\ mI_d\preceq D^2\varphi_p\preceq MI_d,\text{ and ass:shared-rank-scm holds for all }p\in\mathcal A\}\). Noninteger \(C^s\) is the usual Holder class; integer \(C^s\) has bounded classical derivatives through order \(s\).
